name: 92122 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92122 (San Diego) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92122 (San Diego) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92122 (San Diego) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 91 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
